title: Historical Thai Buddhist Solar Calendar
intro: The historical Thai Buddhist solar calendar includes Thailand's April-start civil years and subsequent transition to a January New Year.
structure: From 1 April 1912 until the 1940 transition the year began on 1 April. BE 2483 ran only from April through December 1940. From 1 January 1941 the year begins in January.
model: For April-start dates, Gregorian year + 543 gives the BE year from April through December; January–March use Gregorian year + 542. From 1941 the offset is +543 throughout. Month/day lengths follow the solar civil convention.
example: October 1940 belongs to BE 2483; January 1941 is BE 2484. January–March BE 2483 do not exist and must be rejected. Gregorian 2026 is BE 2569.
history: The 1941 year-start reform distinguishes this chronology from the separate modern Buddhist Era provider.
limits: The supported historical model begins on 1 April 1912; earlier dates and missing dates are rejected. Other regional calendars are not reconstructed.
